items.originalSummary: The RealReal (REAL) came out with quarterly earnings of $0.02 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $0.01 per share. This compares to a loss of $0.49 per share a year ago. These figures are adjusted for non-recurring items. This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of +100.00%. A quarter ago, it was expected that this online luxury consignment site would post a loss of $0.02 per share when it actually produced a loss of $0.01, delivering a surprise of +50%.

items.originalTitle: Auto Chip Demand Fears Put ON Semiconductor (NASDAQ: ON) In The Crosshairs As NXP (NASDAQ: NXPI) Guidance Disappoints
items.originalSummary: Anxiety over slowing automotive semiconductor demand is back, and ON Semiconductor (NASDAQ: ON) is bearing the brunt of it, with shares sliding 5% to $75 in afternoon trading on October 28. The selloff is sharper for ON than for the company whose guidance triggered it, underscoring how much investors view ON Semiconductor’s silicon carbide EV inverter chips as a direct proxy for auto industry health.

historyItems.originalTitle: Hackers Exploited Cisco SD-WAN Flaw to Plant Malware Built to Steal Encryption Keys
historyItems.originalSummary: PHP2Shell security flaws now sucessfully exploited in the wild DreamHost forces password resets in ongoing "incident" Kali Linux 2026.3 released with 6 new tools, desktop updates Critical 'HTTP2Shell' Brotli vulnerability triggers emergency patches How to access the Dark Web using the Tor Browser How to enable Kernel-mode Hardware-enforced Stack Protection in Windows 11 How to backup and restore the Windows Registry A newly identified advanced persistent threat (APT) group tracked as UAT-11473 was observed exploiting CVE-2026-20127, an authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controllers, to deploy a custom malware framework called KeyDrift. CVE-2026-20127 is a max-severity flaw that Cisco patched in February 2026, which allows remote attackers to gain privileged access to Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager and add rogue peers. UAT-8616 has exploited the vulnerability as a zero-day since at least 2023 , and recent research also linked its exploitation to the Chinese Volt Typhoon state-sponsored hacking group.

historyItems.title: SpaceX 供應商意法半導體預測人工智慧和衛星將帶來強勁銷售
historyItems.summary: 作者：Mauro Orru 意法半導體預計今年的銷售將強勁增長，因為為人工智慧模型提供支援的資料中心的建設以及提供連接服務的衛星的部署刺激了對半導體的需求。這家歐洲晶片製造商的客戶包括蘋果和馬斯克旗下的特斯拉和 SpaceX，該公司表示，2026 年營收預計將年增近 23%，達到約 145 億美元。同時，其毛利率（一項受到密切關注的定價能力衡量標準）應會從去年的 33.9% 增加到 36.4% 左右。直到現在，該公司一直沒有提供詳細的年度指引，因為該公司即將進入最後一個季度，以便更好地了解推動需求的因素。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX Supplier STMicroelectronics Forecasts Strong Sales on AI, Satellite Boost
historyItems.originalSummary: By Mauro Orru STMicroelectronics projected robust sales growth for the year as the build-out of data centers to power artificial-intelligence models and the deployment of satellites to provide connectivity services fuel demand for semiconductors. The European chip maker, which counts Apple and Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX among its clients, said 2026 revenue should grow nearly 23% on year to roughly $14.5 billion. Meanwhile, its gross margin--a closely watched measure of pricing power--should increase to about 36.4% from 33.9% last year. The company had refrained from providing detailed annual guidance until now , as it embarks on the final quarter, gaining better visibility into what is driving demand. It expects sales of about $4.15 billion this quarter compared with $3.33 billion a year earlier, above a Visible Alpha forecast of nearly $4.12 billion. Its annual sales projection is also above a Visible Alpha forecast of $14.41 billion. Chief Executive Jean-Marc Chery singled out data centers and satellites as key drivers for growth this year. Like other chip makers, STMicroelectronics is reaping the benefits of hundreds of billions of dollars in spending commitments from some of the world's largest tech groups to build out AI infrastructure. STMicroelectronics stock has nearly doubled in value since the year began, riding a wave of investor fervor around AI that lifted global semiconductor stocks. In a sign of how fast demand for chips to power energy-intensive data centers is building up, STMicroelectronics in July projected revenue from data centers above $1 billion in 2026 and well above $2 billion in 2027 compared with prior guidance of about $1 billion and roughly $2 billion, respectively. That marked the second time the company raised its AI forecasts this year. Alongside data centers, space also provides a key revenue stream for STMicroelectronics and other chip makers that supply semiconductors for low-Earth-orbit satellite constellations. The company expects well above $3 billion in revenue between 2026 and 2028 for the supply of equipment to be used in space, a forecast that for now excludes potential benefits from orbital data centers. Low Earth-orbit satellite networks are closer to Earth than traditional constellations, making them ideal to beam low-latency broadband directly to smartphones in parts of the world where cell towers are unavailable. SpaceX's Starlink provides direct-to-device connectivity to users in several countries, including Ukraine, where damage to terrestrial networks because of the war is common. STMicroelectronics had long relied on the automotive industry to generate a significant portion of its sales. Data centers and satellites have allowed the group to diversify its revenue streams and become less tied to carmakers. The auto industry in recent years had slowly been digesting chip inventories it built at the height of the pandemic, weighing on demand for new orders in a blow to STMicroelectronics. historyItems.summary: 資料中心基礎設施公司 Vertiv Holdings（NYSE：VRT）的股票在 10 月 28 日星期三早盤前的延長交易中經歷了強勁的上漲，從截至發稿時最新的 208.56 美元上漲 16.13%，接近 242.20 美元。這項舉措是上週稍晚開始的 9% 反彈的延續，導致 VRT 股價在周線圖表上下跌 3.50%，在月線圖表上下跌 14.54%。儘管如此，盤前走勢還是幫助抹去了自 10 月 9 日以來遭受的所有損失。 Vertiv 股價最近的上漲是由於一份特別令人印象深刻的收益報告，該報告顯示該公司在營收和每股盈餘 (EPS) 方面都超出了華爾街的預期。
historyItems.originalTitle: Nvidia Partner Vertiv Soars After Blowout Earnings, Strong Guidance
historyItems.originalSummary: The stock of the data center infrastructure company Vertiv Holdings (NYSE: VRT) experienced a powerful rally in the extended session leading toward the Wednesday, October 28, morning bell, rising 16.13% from $208.56 at the latest close to $242.20 at press time. This move came as a continuation of the 9% recovery that started late last week, which left VRT shares 3.50% in the red on the weekly chart and 14.54% down on the monthly chart. Still, the pre-market move helped erase all losses suffered since October 9. Vertiv stock’s latest upsurge came as a result of a particularly impressive earnings report that showed the company beat Wall Street forecasts in terms of both revenue and earnings-per-share (EPS).

historyItems.originalTitle: AI Data Center Supplier Amphenol Jumps On Earnings Beat
historyItems.originalSummary: Burke Wealth Management, an investment management company, released its "Focused Growth Strategy" Q3 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here . The fund delivered strong results in the third quarter of 2026, benefiting from a sharp recovery in enterprise software and solid corporate earnings amid continued market volatility. The composite returned 10.8% net of fees, substantially outperforming the S&P 500 Total Return Index's 2.3% gain, while its year-to-date return reached 20.0%, compared with 12.7% for the benchmark. The firm attributed the quarter's strength partly to investors reassessing the long-term value of enterprise software platforms that can securely connect AI models with proprietary business data. Burke believes these platforms can serve as essential AI "harnesses," providing permissions, security, and context for enterprise applications, although it cautions that AI agents could challenge traditional software business models and seat-based pricing. Looking ahead, Burke remains optimistic about the remainder of 2026, citing strong corporate earnings growth and the transition from AI infrastructure investment toward practical applications that may improve productivity and consumer experiences. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX.O) | Stock Price & Latest News
historyItems.originalSummary: Fred Alger Management , an investment management company, released its "Alger Spectra Fund" third-quarter 2026 investor letter. The letter can be downloaded here . During the third quarter of 2026, U.S. equities delivered modest gains, with the S&P 500 advancing 2%. Despite robust corporate earnings and resilient consumer spending, market breadth remained weak as 60% of S&P 500 constituents closed lower. Against this backdrop, the fund lagged the Russell 3000 Growth Index. Class A shares of the fund returned 0.29% without a sales charge and -4.98% with sales charges, compared to 0.45% for the index. Consumer Discretionary and Tech drove the relative performance, whereas Communication Services and Utilities dragged. Macro headwinds weighed on sectors like Energy following oil supply disruptions. On the short side, a position in an IT consulting firm detracted from returns, while a short in an advertising technology company generated positive gains following its weak earnings report and rising competitive threats. Amid these shifting dynamics, the fund continues to prioritize disciplined stock selection to capture long-term opportunities across the expanding AI ecosystem. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Vertiv stock surges as orders double amid AI build-out: 'Evolving faster than ever'
historyItems.originalSummary: Vertiv ( VRT ) stock surged 13% as the data center infrastructure player showed it continues to benefit from the massive spending from the likes of Google ( GOOG ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ). "We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating," Vertiv's CEO Giordano Albertazzi stated in the company's earnings release . "The demands on data center infrastructure are evolving faster than ever, and Vertiv's role in that buildout keeps expanding."

historyItems.originalTitle: Snowflake and Oracle Expand Their Partnership to Bring the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to OCI
historyItems.originalSummary: New first-party service gives customers more choice and flexibility to accelerate enterprise AI initiatives and realize business value faster LAS VEGAS, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle AI World -- Oracle and Snowflake (NYSE: SNOW) today announced that Snowflake AI Data Cloud will be available as a native, first-party service on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), further expanding the AI and data capabilities Oracle offers to help organizations accelerate enterprise AI initiatives. By making Snowflake available alongside Oracle's comprehensive portfolio of infrastructure, AI, data, and application services, Oracle will give customers greater flexibility to put their enterprise data to work and drive AI-powered innovation. Customers will be able to purchase and provision the offering directly through Oracle, with simplified pricing and billing, alongside the ability to use Oracle Universal Credits.

historyItems.originalTitle: Google and Oracle are partnering to bring Google TPUs to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
historyItems.originalSummary: OCI will be the first hyperscaler outside Google to offer Google TPUsLAS VEGAS, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle AI World -- Oracle and Google today announced that Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) will be available through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), marking the first time Google TPUs will be offered on a hyperscale cloud platform outside Google. By bringing Google's purpose-built TPUs to OCI's AI compute portfolio, customers gain the flexibility to match their most demanding workloads with infrastructure designed for near-linear scalability and highly optimized economics. "Different AI workloads have different compute needs," said Mahesh Thiagarajan, president, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle. "Bringing Google TPUs to OCI gives customers access to multiple leading AI compute architectures in one cloud. That choice gives them the flexibility to choose the right infrastructure for the performance, throughput, and economics of each AI workload."Google TPUs are custom accelerators co-designed with open software to power the entire AI lifecycle—from frontier training and large-scale inference to the multi-step reasoning data demands of agentic AI. OCI will provide the power, cooling, and datacenter networking to deploy Google TPUs at scale within its infrastructure."The next generation of AI will require a diverse range of compute," said Amin Vahdat, senior vice president and chief technologist, AI & Infrastructure, Google. "TPUs give customers a powerful, purpose-built option for demanding training and inference workloads. Bringing Google TPUs to OCI will give more organizations access to this technology and greater flexibility in how they build and run their most complex AI applications."More AI Compute Options for Every WorkloadAs models grow and production inference demands increase, the performance and economics of every training run and inference request become increasingly important. Google's TPU architecture is designed to maximize AI processing from each watt of electricity, with fast access to model data and rapid communication between chips.Google TPUs can support large-model training and post-training, including dense and mixture-of-experts models (MoE), as well as production inference for reasoning, agentic, and long-context applications. Customers will be able to choose Google TPUs within OCI, optimized for their workloads, performance requirements, and cost objectives.Drawing on more than a decade of custom AI silicon development, Google's TPU portfolio delivers purpose-built compute optimized for massive machine learning workloads. Google's eighth-generation TPU introduces two purpose-built architectures: TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference. TPU 8t cuts frontier model development cycles from months to weeks, delivering nearly 3x the compute performance per pod over the previous generation, while TPU 8i is designed to handle the iterative work of many specialized agents.Google TPUs on OCI will be available in calendar year 2027, ramping over a multi-year period to meet customer needs.Additional ResourcesLearn more about Oracle C

historyItems.originalTitle: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
historyItems.originalSummary: OpenAI said it is expanding its partnership with Oracle to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT, while also helping power new Oracle offerings, according to an OpenAI announcement published on Oct. 27, 2026. The update extends a relationship that has already moved beyond infrastructure and into enterprise distribution. In its announcement, OpenAI said the companies are working to place Oracle business applications and AI agents inside ChatGPT, and to support new Oracle products through the collaboration. The statement did not include pricing, rollout timing, customer counts or a product launch schedule. The partnership has been building through multiple prior steps. OpenAI said on Aug. 7, 2026 that eligible Oracle Universal Credits can be used to purchase OpenAI API models, Codex and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace. Oracle also said on Oct. 16, 2026 that its own employees were adopting Enterprise ChatGPT as part of its AI-transformation update, indicating internal use of OpenAI software within the company. The expansion comes against a broader backdrop of joint infrastructure development. Oracle said in a June 11, 2024 announcement with Microsoft and OpenAI that Oracle Cloud Infrastructure would supply additional capacity by extending Microsoft’s Azure AI platform. OpenAI later named Oracle among the initial equity funders in its Jan. 21, 2025 Stargate announcement, which outlined an intention to invest $500 billion in U.S. AI infrastructure over four years. OpenAI then said on July 22, 2025 that it had agreed with Oracle to develop an additional 4.5 gigawatts of U.S. Stargate capacity, taking the total described in that update to more than 5 gigawatts under development and more than 2 million chips. Those figures described planned development, not already completed capacity. Oracle’s current infrastructure page, as of September 2026, said Abilene had delivered 75% of total capacity, while customer delivery at Shackelford and Doña Ana County was scheduled to begin in the first half of 2027. That timeline gives the partnership a physical infrastructure layer, while the new OpenAI announcement points to a broader software and distribution tie-up. There were no verified details in the source material on financial terms, revenue impact, exclusivity, or an official launch date for the new ChatGPT integrations. The timing of any further product rollout remains unknown from the supplied material.

Energy, Technology, and Health Care sectors excelled, while Utilities, Industrials, Real Estate, and Consumer Discretionary lagged. Market breadth was narrow, with many stocks remaining significantly below their 52-week highs. The Russell 1000 Growth returned 0.9%, while large-cap stocks outperformed small-cap. Bonds experienced negative returns as 30-year U.S. Treasury yields rose, influenced by fiscal concerns and geopolitical tensions. The Federal Reserve raised interest rates in response to unexpected economic growth and persistent inflation. S&P 500 earnings soared 52% year-over-year, buoyed by selected mark-to-market gains, with future estimates being upgraded. Free cash flow growth has been mixed due to investments in AI and infrastructure, but broader market prospects are improving. Also, check the Fund's top five holdings to see its best picks for 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
historyItems.originalSummary: Meta Platforms Inc. today announced that Nvidia Corp. and Advanced Micro Devices Inc. plan to buy $4 billion worth of its shares. The chipmakers will purchase the equity as part of an up to $95 billion stock sale that the Facebook parent intends to kick off in the near future. The fundraising initiative will also include the participation of Broadcom Inc. Meta didn’t specify how much the company is investing, but it stated on Monday that Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom together plan to invest $5 billion. That suggests the networking chip giant will buy $1 billion in shares. Nvidia is investing $3 billion as part of a newly expanded partnership that also includes other components. Notably, Meta plans to broaden its use of the chipmaker’s Rubin graphics processing units and Vera central processing units. Companies often deploy the two chips together in Nvidia-designed DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 appliances. Each system includes 72 GPUs and 36 CPUs. Meta also plans to buy more Nvidia networking gear. It will expand its use of the Spectrum-X Ethernet product family, which includes SuperNICs and switches. SuperNICs are chips that connect servers to a data center’s network, while switches coordinate how traffic flows through that network. GPU clusters’ traffic patterns tend to change rapidly. As a result, connectivity bottlenecks sometimes emerge faster than the network can respond to them. Nvidia says that its Spectrum-X Ethernet product series addresses the challenge by checking GPU traffic for anomalies at sub-microsecond time intervals. A microsecond corresponds to one millionth of a second. Another focus of Meta’s planned network investment is Nvidia’s BlueField-4 chip family. The accelerators in the series are designed to speed common networking, storage and cybersecurity tasks. Nvidia will help Meta improve the performance and cost efficiency of its Muse large language model family. The effort will extend to the Facebook parent’s eponymous consumer AI agent. Additionally, Meta plans to explore “collaboration opportunities” related to Nvidia’s recently introduced OpenShell Reference Architecture. It’s a collection of technical resources that makes it easier to run the chipmaker’s OpenShell toolkit. The toolkit runs AI agents in isolated sandboxes designed to mitigate cybersecurity risks. “Nvidia and Meta are expanding our partnership to optimize the computing infrastructure end to end for capable, efficient and secure AI agents, so Muse can empower billions of people to achieve more and pursue greater ambitions,” said Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang. AMD, which will invest $1 billion in Meta, today revealed that the Facebook parent has adopted its Helios rack design. Helios contains 72 GPUs much like the DGX Vera Rubin NVL72. It’s based on AMD’s latest Instinct MI450 graphics card architecture, Epyc CPUs and Pensando data processing units, which are the chipmaker’s answer to the BlueField-4.

historyItems.originalTitle: Introducing Cisco Model Foundry: Bringing AI to our partners
historyItems.originalSummary: A year ago, the answer to “which model should we use?” was simple: whichever frontier model topped the leaderboard that week. Then open models caught up. They cost a fraction as much, you could run them where you wanted, and your data stayed yours. Plenty of teams made the switch. Then they pointed those models at real work. An operator reports that R2 lost every route from R1, but ping across the link still works. A security team needs to find the three files in a million-line codebase most likely to hold a vulnerability. An observability team needs to spot the one interface that matters in a week of telemetry. This is where general-purpose models, open or closed, start to struggle. We think the next leap comes from a model that already knows the domain and then learns your customer. That second step runs on your data and your relationships, and it’s where partners lead. Today at Partner Summit, we’re introducing Cisco Model Foundry , a new platform service in Cisco Cloud Control. It gives partners access to Cisco’s purpose-built models and lets them serve those models in customer applications. When the use case calls for it, partners can also fine-tune the models on their customers’ own data, all in one place. Access Cisco’s domain models. Model Foundry opens up the models Cisco has built on four decades of networking, security, and operations knowledge. Several of them previously ran only inside our own products. Browse the catalog, open the Playground, paste in a real problem, and see how each model handles it before you commit. Put them to work. In Model Foundry, you create an API key, set an expiration, choose a model, and you’re connected. The API is OpenAI-compatible, so it plugs into the agents, tools, and workflows you already run. Administrators get tenant-scoped keys, per-model access controls, and full visibility into usage by model, key, and day. Tailor it when it counts. Fine-tuning means taking the knowledge that makes a network or a business unique and training the model on it. It’s built for the large volumes of data that partners and customers already have: configs, log messages, alerts, tickets, and agent traces from thousands of devices. Model Foundry handles the hard parts, from the GPUs to the training pipeline to built-in evaluation that runs the base and tuned models side by side. You see where tuning helped, and where it didn’t, before anything reaches production. Many partners don’t need to fine-tune to get value. A purpose-built Cisco model, served as-is, is built to outperform generic open models on domain work. Fine-tuning is there for the moments when “good” isn’t good enough.

historyItems.originalTitle: Unusual Machines Completes Upgrade Energy Acquisition

historyItems.title: Verizon 提升前景，與亞馬遜簽署價值超過 20 億美元的交易
historyItems.summary: 作者：Kelly Cloonan Verizon Communications 再次上調了全年展望，因為該公司繼續為其後付費電話服務吸引新客戶。這家行動營運商也在周一表示，它與亞馬遜網路服務公司簽署了一項價值超過 20 億美元的協議，為代理商和生成人工智慧工作負載提供暗光纖。該協議是繼今年稍早與 Alphabet 旗下谷歌達成的類似協議之後達成的，該協議的估值超過 10 億美元。執行長 Dan Schulman 在與分析師的電話會議上表示：“這兩份合約是一個明確的信號，表明全球最大的人工智慧基礎設施建設者正在選擇 Verizon 作為戰略連接合作夥伴。”
historyItems.originalTitle: Verizon Lifts Outlook, Inks Amazon Deal Worth More Than $2 Billion
historyItems.originalSummary: By Kelly Cloonan Verizon Communications boosted its full-year outlook again as it continues to attract new customers for its postpaid phone service. The mobile carrier also on Monday said it signed a deal valued at more than $2 billion with Amazon Web Services to supply dark fiber for agentic and generative artificial-intelligence workloads. The agreement follows a similar deal earlier this year with Alphabet's Google, which was valued at more than $1 billion. "These two contracts are a clear signal that the largest builders of AI infrastructure in the world are choosing Verizon as a strategic connectivity partner," Chief Executive Dan Schulman said during a call with analysts. Schulman said Verizon is in talks with additional hyperscalers, neocloud providers and large enterprise clients to supply fiber connectivity. The company is also seeing momentum with several partners looking to use its network hubs for AI inference and edge computing, he said. Verizon gained a net 406,000 postpaid phone connections in the latest quarter, marking its strongest third-quarter performance on the closely watched metric in five years. Analysts polled by FactSet expected 195,300 postpaid phone net additions. Schulman said the company is gaining loyal, high-value customers as it shifts away from heavy subsidies to focus on other offerings, like its expanded loyalty program and its Simplicity plan, which it rolled out earlier this year. "We are not buying customers. We are winning them on revenue-positive terms and keeping them longer," Schulman said during a call with analysts. The postpaid strength helped Verizon post higher third-quarter profit and revenue. Schulman, who took the helm of Verizon last October, said the latest quarterly results are proof that it's evolved into a structurally different company. "Verizon is in a fundamentally better position operationally, financially and competitively," Schulman said. "Our transformation has taken root and our results show it." The latest results prompted the company to raise its full-year guidance for the third consecutive quarter. Verizon now expects adjusted earnings per share of $5.04 to $5.06 for the full year, compared with its prior view of $4.99 to $5.04, and now projects total full-year postpaid phone net additions of about 1.1 million to 1.2 million, up from a previous range of 875,000 to one million. The company also raised its projection for mobility and broadband service revenue growth to be in the upper half of its prior forecast of 2.5% to 3% for the year. Wall Street projects adjusted earnings of $5 per share and postpaid phone net additions of 975,000 for the year. Verizon's third-quarter profit came in at $5.3 billion, or $1.25 a share, compared with $5.06 billion, or $1.17 a share, a year earlier. Adjusted earnings per share were $1.31, compared with analyst estimates of $1.27. Revenue ticked up 1.5% to $34.3 billion, compared with analyst estimates of $34.77 billion. Mobility and broadband service revenue rose 2.9% to $23.5 billion. Equipment revenue declined 9%, as consumers continue to hold on to their mobile devices for longer before

(NYSE American:UMAC), a leading manufacturer of NDAA-compliant drone components, today announced that it has received a $16.9 million purchase order from Powerus Corporation (Nasdaq:PUSA), a U.S. defense technology company focused on autonomous and unmanned systems. The order covers critical drone components, including motors, batteries, cameras, and video transmitters (VTX), for use across Powerus’s unmanned systems portfolio “The need for effective autonomous and counter-drone systems is growing rapidly, and Powerus is turning that urgency into action,” said Allan Evans, CEO of Unusual Machines. “This latest order builds on our partnership and underscores the importance of a reliable domestic supply chain behind those systems.” The order expands the companies’ commercial relationship as Powerus scales production to meet growing demand. It follows a previous order exceeding $5 million, announced in April 2026, and a $30 million strategic equity investment by Unusual Machines in Powerus, disclosed in June 2026. “The autonomous systems we deliver to our global customers support missions across incredibly complex and evolving operating environments,” said Brett Velicovich, Co-founder and President at Powerus. “Working with Unusual Machines in the U.S. means we can deliver critical products faster and more affordably to our customers, no matter where they are.” Unusual Machines is a leading provider of NDAA-compliant drone components, focused on building a domestic supply chain for the growing U.S. drone industry. The Company manufactures a broad portfolio of critical components, including flight controllers, electronic speed controllers, video systems, motors, FPV headsets, cameras and, following its acquisition of Upgrade Energy, batteries and power systems. Unusual Machines is expanding U.S. manufacturing to meet increasing demand from defense, enterprise, and commercial customers, while serving the consumer FPV market through its Fat Shark and Rotor Riot brands. According to Fact.MR, the U.S. drone components market represents a $3 billion to $5 billion opportunity. For more information, visit unusualmachines.com . Powerus Corporation (formerly Aureus Greenway Holdings Inc., Nasdaq:PUSA) builds and scales unified autonomous systems designed to move, protect, and sustain critical assets in high-risk environments, with capabilities spanning heavy-lift platforms, autonomous air systems, autonomous maritime systems, mission systems, training and support, and U.S.-based manufacturing. Powerus Corporation also owns and manages two golf courses in the Orlando, Florida region. On October 1, 2026, Powerus completed its previously announced merger with AGH; shares continue trading on Nasdaq under the symbol PUSA. Learn more at power.us. Investor: investors@unusualmachines.com Media: media@unusualmachines.com Investor Relations: Santosh Patel ir@power.us 404-314-8141

historyItems.originalSummary: Ariel Investments , an investment management company, released its "Ariel Appreciation Fund" Q3 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here . Copy main article 1st para. The Fund faced a challenging third quarter of 2026 as rising interest rates, higher energy prices, persistent inflation, and geopolitical uncertainty weighed on mid-cap equities, despite gains in the broader U.S. market. The Fund's Investor Class returned -3.90%, underperforming the Russell Midcap Value Index, which declined 1.98%, and the Russell Midcap Index, which fell 3.00%. Strong earnings, improved guidance, and better operating performance supported several holdings, while concerns about near-term demand, margins, and execution pressured others. The portfolio also experienced weakness in cruise-related and food-equipment businesses, reflecting softer travel trends, higher fuel costs, inflationary pressures, and investor concerns about near-term profitability. During the quarter, the Fund exited its position in a cruise operator and redeployed the proceeds into another major cruise company, sold an electronic-payments holding, and added exposure to a security, residential technology, and fire-safety distribution business following its spin-off. The Fund also received shares in a newly separated food-processing business. Looking ahead, Ariel expects volatility to persist as inflation, monetary policy, and economic growth remain uncertain. The firm views market dislocations as opportunities to acquire quality businesses trading below intrinsic value, emphasizing durable competitive advantages, strong balance sheets, cash generation, and long-term earnings potential. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

historyItems.originalSummary: Amkor Technology (AMKR) has investors recalibrating expectations after its latest earnings. Third quarter results brought record revenue in Computing and Automotive & Industrial, yet overall sales and profit landed below Wall Street forecasts. Short term sentiment has swung sharply, with Amkor Technology's share price down 6.34% on the day of the earnings release and 31.34% over 30 days. However, the 1-year total shareholder return of 11.71% and 3-year total shareholder return of 88.77% still point to a much stronger longer term story that investors are now reassessing against the latest guidance and AI related expansion plans.

historyItems.originalSummary: Interested in Centrus Energy Corp.? Here are five stocks we like better. Centrus Energy completed a $116 million acquisition of Westerman Holdings on Oct. 16 to secure its primary centrifuge-component manufacturing supply chain. Despite falling nearly 55% year-to-date on dilution concerns from a $500 million stock offering, Centrus holds a $3.7 billion uranium enrichment backlog and a $900 million Department of Energy contract. Zacks Research upgraded Centrus to Strong-Buy with a consensus price target near $225, implying over 100% upside as nuclear fuel demand grows.

historyItems.summary: Investing.com——週五，在彭博新聞報導該火箭公司正在討論獲得美國至少 80,000 個蜂窩基地台的接入權後，SpaceX 股價週五在美國盤前交易中上漲超過 2%。彭博社報道稱，此舉將標誌著朝著建立第四家全國性無線營運商邁出了具體的一步。據稱，這家衛星巨頭正在與包括 Crown Castle International Corp （NYSE：CCI）在內的主要塔營運商進行談判，以收集補充其軌道網路所需的實體基礎設施。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX in Talks to Access 80,000 Cell Sites for New Network
historyItems.originalSummary: Investing.com -- SpaceX shares rose by more than 2% in premarket U.S. trading on Friday after Bloomberg News reported that the rocket company is in discussions to secure access to at least 80,000 cell sites across the United States. Bloomberg reported that the move would signal a concrete step toward establishing a fourth nationwide wireless carrier. The satellite giant is said to be negotiating with major tower operators, including Crown Castle International Corp (NYSE:CCI), as it gathers the physical infrastructure required to complement its orbital network. Crown Castle shares surged by more than 7% premarket.

historyItems.originalTitle: Purdue, GlobalFoundries expand partnership with master research agreement
historyItems.originalSummary: WEST LAFAYETTE, Ind. (WLFI) - Purdue University has announced a master research agreement with GlobalFoundries, a manufacturer of essential semiconductors. Purdue says the agreement will significantly expand the university’s research capabilities, and bolster the talent pipeline in the semi-conductor ecosystem. The agreement builds upon a strategic partnership first announced in November 2022. Purdue says it will create a streamlined framework for multiple collaborative projects. Under the unified framework, Purdue says the agreement enables new research initiatives to launch quickly and efficiently, accelerating innovation in semiconductor technology. Since 2023, GlobalFoundries has hosted students from Purdue’s summer training, awareness, and readiness for semiconductors program at its U.S. headquarters.

historyItems.originalTitle: Bloom Energy Lifts Outlook, Logs Higher Profit
historyItems.originalSummary: By Katherine Hamilton Deckers Outdoor cut its outlook, citing a highly promotional shoe industry. Shares slid 7% to $79.15 in after-hours trading Thursday. Sallie Mae lowered its outlook after logging higher charge-offs in the latest quarter. The stock declined 5% to $21.76. Western Digital's latest earnings report wasn't enough to get the stock back on track after investors sold off AI shares during day trading. Shares were down 5% to $336.50 after the bell. Bloom Energy had a negative cash flow in the latest quarter as it continued to spend heavily. The stock fell 5% to $206.21. Write to Katherine Hamilton at katherine.hamilton@wsj.com (END) Dow Jones Newswires 10-22-26 1912ET

historyItems.originalTitle: TTM Technologies Fiscal Q3 non-GAAP Earnings, Revenue Rise; Initiates Fiscal 2027 Preliminary Outlook
historyItems.originalSummary: Interested in TTM Technologies, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better. TTM Technologies delivered record third-quarter results: Revenue rose 60% year over year to $1.2 billion, while non-GAAP earnings per share more than doubled to $1.46. Adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 20.1% from 16.1%, driven by stronger volume, favorable product mix and execution gains. Data Center & Networking led growth, with sales up 115% and accounting for 41% of revenue, as demand increased for higher-value N+M circuit boards. Aerospace and defense also remained strong, with a record $2 billion backlog and a 1.6 book-to-bill ratio. TTM raised its 2026 outlook to $4.47 billion-$4.49 billion in revenue and issued preliminary 2027 guidance of $6.5 billion-$6.75 billion. The company is planning an additional $400 million capacity investment and pursuing acquisitions, including the proposed $650 million purchase of Ophir Optics.

historyItems.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) 透過 14 天的人工智慧工廠建置真正改變了什麼？
historyItems.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co（NYSE：VRT）和 NVIDIA 推出了 DSX POD 模組化 AI 工廠參考設計，目標是 14 天的部署週期。 DSX POD 使用預先設計的電源和冷卻模組以及進階虛擬化來縮短傳統的 6 個月的 AI 建置時間。 Vertiv 正在挪威運行多階段 DSX POD 實施，並與達梭系統合作以虛擬方式設計和驗證 AI 工廠。 DSX POD 的推出和虛擬雙胞胎工作指向了比單一 AI 工廠藍圖更廣泛的 Vertiv 故事。
historyItems.originalTitle: What Is Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Really Changing With 14 Day AI Factory Builds?
historyItems.originalSummary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) and NVIDIA launched a DSX POD modular AI factory reference design that targets 14 day deployment cycles. The DSX POD uses pre engineered power and cooling modules plus advanced virtualization to shorten traditional 6 month AI build timelines. Vertiv is running a multiphase DSX POD implementation in Norway and teaming with Dassault Systèmes to virtually design and validate AI factories. The DSX POD rollout and virtual twin work point to a broader Vertiv story than this single AI factory blueprint. Take a look at 4 other big wins we have identified for Vertiv Holdings Co. The acceleration in AI factory deployment highlighted by Vertiv and NVIDIA flags a wider build out trend that deserves closer attention via 55 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.summary: 國際商業機器公司 IBM 公佈了強勁的 2026 年第三季業績，調整後收益年增 11% 至每股 2.95 美元。該數字比 Zacks 的普遍預期 2.88 美元高出 2.4%。營收成長 4.7%，達到 171 億美元，比市場預期的 168.7 億美元高出 1.4%。上行反映了軟體和基礎設施成長的加速、交易執行和生產力計劃的改善。
historyItems.originalTitle: IBM Stock Rises After-Hours, Tops Q3 Revenue Estimates On Software Strength And Recovery In Delayed Contracts
historyItems.originalSummary: International Business Machines Corporation IBM reported strong third-quarter 2026 results, with adjusted earnings rising 11% year over year to $2.95 per share. The figure beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $2.88 by 2.4%. Revenues increased 4.7% to $17.10 billion, surpassing the consensus mark of $16.87 billion by 1.4%. The upside reflected accelerating Software and Infrastructure growth, improved transaction execution and productivity initiatives. Software annual recurring revenue (ARR) reached $24.9 billion, up 8% year over year. Operating pre-tax margin expanded 70 basis points (bps).

historyItems.originalTitle: LRCX: Record revenue and earnings, with December-quarter guidance for $8.60B revenue
historyItems.originalSummary: Revenue: $8.22 billion, up 22% sequentially and 54% year-over-year; fifth consecutive quarter of record revenue. Gross Margin: Record 52.4%, up from 52% in the June quarter on favorable customer and product mix. Operating Margin: Record 40.2%, up from 38.4% in the June quarter; first time topping 40%. Diluted EPS: Record $2.20; diluted share count ~1.26 billion. Operating Expenses: $1 billion, up from $916 million prior quarter; R&D ~two-thirds of total. Deferred Revenue: $2.66 billion, up $227 million from the June quarter. Memory Systems Revenue: 46% of systems revenue (record dollar level), up 120% year-over-year; NAND 26% of systems revenue (up from 23%), NAND dollars up ~40% sequentially; DRAM 20% of systems revenue (down from 23%), record dollar level. Foundry Systems Revenue: Record; 46% of systems revenue, up from 44% in the June quarter. Logic and Other Systems Revenue: 8% of systems revenue, down from 10% in the June quarter. CSBG Revenue: Fourth consecutive record quarter at nearly $2.5 billion, up slightly sequentially and 40% year-over-year; calendar 2026 growth expected above 30% year-over-year, with over 15% growth expected in calendar 2027.

historyItems.summary: 諾基亞將 AI-RAN 推向商業部署和物理人工智能，與德國柏林的 NVIDIA 合作推出用於電信自治的主權代理人工智能平台 - 諾基亞今天宣布瞭如何與 NVIDIA 合作將人工智能原生網絡帶入商業現實的下一步，其中包括在無線電處理中應用人工智能的新功能，支持靠近數據生成位置的智能，並擴展受管人工智能代理以進行跨域網絡操作代理。 AI-RAN 建立在 7 月宣布的業界首個商用 AI-RAN 平台的基礎上，正在整合到現網中並且距離部署更近了。
historyItems.originalTitle: Nokia advances AI-RAN toward commercial deployment and physical AI, launches sovereign agentic AI platform for telco autonomy with NVIDIA
historyItems.originalSummary: Nokia advances AI-RAN toward commercial deployment and physical AI, launches sovereign agentic AI platform for telco autonomy with NVIDIA Berlin, Germany – Nokia today announced the next step in how it is bringing AI-native networks to commercial reality with NVIDIA, with new capabilities that apply AI within radio processing, support intelligence close to where data is generated and extend governed AI agents for cross-domain network operations. Building on the industry’s first commercial AI-RAN platform, announced in July, AI-RAN is being integrated into live networks and moving closer to deployment. Together, Nokia and NVIDIA are creating the real-time network foundation needed for physical-AI applications while giving operators a practical path to improve today’s 5G and 5G Advanced networks and evolve to AI-native 6G. Customer progress moves AI-RAN closer to deployment One year ago, Nokia and NVIDIA formed a partnership to add NVIDIA-powered, commercial-grade AI-RAN products to Nokia’s radio access network portfolio. The companies are now applying AI within the 5G signal-processing chain, including channel estimation, beamforming, multi-user MIMO pairing and scheduling. Nokia AI-native anyRAN software, running on NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer, provides a software-defined foundation for integrating AI-powered radio functions that improve network capacity and performance.

historyItems.originalTitle: Unusual Machines: The Multibagger In The Making For U.S. Drone Supply (NYSE:UMAC)

historyItems.originalSummary: The moment is now for Elon Musk to dial back founder mode at SpaceX ( SPCX ) and dial back up something else he is very good at: charming visionary founder who is asking for large sums of capital from people who want entry to the Muskverse. Because judging by Musk's commentary on his late Tuesday earnings call, he will need a lot of fresh capital to deliver on aggressive growth timelines for Terrafab, Starlink broadband and rocket reusability. Perhaps way more than most investors think.

historyItems.originalSummary: Meta ( META ) kicked off Big Tech's earnings season after the bell Wednesday, beating expectations on revenue, but GAAP earnings per share took a hit as a result of legal fees related to its teen mental health settlement. historyItems.originalTitle: Why Elon Musk Wants to Merge SpaceX and Tesla
historyItems.originalSummary: Elon Musk has spent years building Tesla and SpaceX into a pair of trillion-dollar technology empires. Now, he is considering bringing them together . Asked on Tuesday whether a merger would be a good idea, Musk was clear: "Yes." The prospect is more than hypothetical. Musk said special committees have been formed to assess a potential deal, although he stressed that there is no guarantee a merger will happen and that nothing has been agreed.

historyItems.summary: 伊隆馬斯克在周二的第三季財報電話會議上表示，特斯拉和 SpaceX 已經成立了特別委員會來討論可能的合併。擔任兩家公司執行長的馬斯克表示，特別委員會是應股東的要求成立的，由獨立董事組成（儘管他沒有透露姓名）。他還指出，他不是這兩個委員會的成員，也沒有參與任何討論。 「因為我是一個衝突方，所以我實際上無法參與特別委員會的討論，」馬斯克說。
historyItems.originalTitle: A possible SpaceX-Tesla merger? Here's what people are saying
historyItems.originalSummary: Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a possible merger, Elon Musk said during the latter’s third quarter earnings call Tuesday. Musk, who serves as CEO of both companies, said the special committees were formed at the request of shareholders and consist of independent directors (though he did not name them). He also noted that he is not a member of either committee, nor involved in any of the discussions. “Because I’m a conflicted party, I can’t actually be in the discussions of the special committees,” Musk said. “So it’s an odd kabuki dance where two groups of people are talking and I can’t be in the conversation.” The groups have not reached agreement on the terms of any transaction — and there’s no guarantee that they will. “At the end of the day, the shareholders have to be supportive of this,” he continued. “And particularly on the Tesla side, we will need a 50 percent vote of all shares, not just those who vote, but of all shareholders. And that’s quite a high hurdle to try to achieve.” That said, Musk called the possibility of a Tesla-SpaceX merger a “good idea.” He continued: > I do think there’s a lot of merit to combining companies as we are pretty much in the superintelligence singularity. And there’s a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing superintelligence software, chip design, the TeraFab, obviously robotics, mass to orbit with the Starmind constellation, connectivity. So I think it would be a good idea, but it’s really up to the special committees of both companies. They’ve got to come up with something and then that’s going to be put to the shareholders as a vote. A Tesla-SpaceX merger would be a blockbuster corporate deal creating a mega-entity valued upwards of $3.6 trillion. But combining Musk’s car and energy company with his AI and rocket company would not be without its tradeoffs. A lot depends on which company absorbs the other. To buy SpaceX, Tesla would have to create millions of new stock shares, which for current Tesla owners would mean owning a smaller slice of a much larger pie. SpaceX’s launch goals require tens of billions of dollars every year — extra spending that could drain Tesla’s ability to build new car factories and battery plants. That said, most Wall Street analysts and legal experts believe SpaceX would acquire Tesla (or absorb it through a stock swap) rather than vice versa. Since its IPO, SpaceX has maintained a higher valuation than Tesla. A merger in that direction would allow SpaceX shareholders to hold the majority control of the combined mega-entity. Some Tesla shareholders may balk at this deal. But it would also create one company for those who believe in Musk’s vision of the future — robot cars, humanoid robots, AI super-intelligence, and human habitats on Mars — in which to place their investments. And Tesla shareholder approved Musk’s enormous pay package last year — even after a Delaware judge tossed it over lack of independence. Earlier this month, Barclays published a client note suggesting a potential Tesla-SpaceX combination could be announced ahead of Tesla’s annual shareholder meeting scheduled for December 3, 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Tesla and SpaceX Formed Committees to Discuss Potential Merger, Elon Musk Says
historyItems.originalSummary: Wall Street is sounding bullish on SpaceX ahead of its third-quarter earnings report, to be delivered after the bell on Tuesday. Mizuho has an outperform rating on the stock and a $200 price target, per a Monday note from analyst Brett Linzey. Shares were trading around $148 as of 10:45 a.m. on Tuesday. "AI is the largest swing factor for 3Q26 revenue and EBITDA. Consensus has AI revenue of $6.30B (+146% Q/Q from $2.56B) and AI adj. EBITDA of $3.32B (from $1.15B)," he wrote. Analysts are expecting some conversation about deals or competitive plays with cable and telecom companies following SpaceX's acquisition of low-band spectrum earlier this month. "We expect initial strategic commentary centers around Connectivity and how SPCX can partner/compete its way into global markets, although we think low-band distribution becomes a meaningful intelligence lever over time," Colin Canfield at Cantor Fitzgerald wrote in a Monday note. He has a price target of $246 and an overweight rating on the stock. Oppenheimer's expectations are more measured. The bank thinks the quarter will be "in-line" with "guidance reiterated." "Industry subscriber growth is slowing with limited room for pricing action, so focus is shifting from net adds and service revenue growth toward cost-cutting using AI, and lower subsidies/churn," Timothy Horan at Oppenheimer told clients in a Tuesday note. He expects "more rational incumbent behavior" from SpaceX's competitors. –Tobias Burns

historyItems.originalTitle: Space X and Tesla exploring merger, CEO Elon Musk says
historyItems.originalSummary: It's official: Tesla and SpaceX are in talks. Independent board members at the two Elon Musk-led companies have formed special committees to hash over a possible merger, Musk told investors during SpaceX's third-quarter earnings call Tuesday. "These special committees consist of independent directors, and because I'm a conflicted party, I can't actually be in the discussions of the special committees," said Musk, who was asked about a potential combination during the call. "This is definitely the kind of question where I feel like I'm tap dancing through a minefield."

historyItems.title: 波音大型 737 Max 噴射機獲得美國批准
historyItems.summary: 經過涉及近 1,000 次飛行和超過 2,000 飛行小時的測試計劃後，美國聯邦航空管理局 (FAA) 已對波音 737 MAX 10 進行了認證，這是 737 MAX 系列中最大的飛機。此次批准為波音在未來幾個月內開始交付 737-10 掃清了道路。該飛機最多可容納 230 名乘客，是該公司單通道 737 MAX 系列中載客量最高的機型。該認證經過了廣泛的安全評估、設計審查和地面測試。
historyItems.originalTitle: Boeing’s Large 737 Max Jet Secures U.S. Approval
historyItems.originalSummary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has certified Boeing’s 737 MAX 10, the largest aircraft in the 737 MAX family, following a testing program involving nearly 1,000 flights and more than 2,000 flight hours.The approval clears the path for Boeing to begin delivering the 737-10 in the coming months. The aircraft can accommodate up to 230 passengers, making it the highest-capacity model in the company’s single-aisle 737 MAX lineup.The certification follows extensive safety assessments, design reviews, and ground testing. Boeing said the program included 1,000 ground test hours, tens of thousands of pages of documentation and formal reviews with the FAA.The 737-10 is also the first commercial aircraft certified under the full requirements of the 2020 Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act. The law introduced stricter requirements for documenting aircraft safety assessments and evaluating how pilots interact with aircraft systems.New safety requirements applyWhat sets the aircraft apart is its enhanced angle-of-attack system, which Boeing plans to introduce across the 737 MAX family.Angle of attack refers to the angle between an aircraft wing and the airflow approaching it. The measurement helps pilots and onboard systems assess flight conditions, including the risk of an aerodynamic stall.Boeing says the upgraded system is designed to reduce pilot workload. Its introduction across the MAX family makes the 737-10 an important step in the company’s broader aircraft safety program.“Our flight test team ran a disciplined, methodical campaign to validate every system,” said Chris Payne, vice president and general manager of 737 Airplane Development Programs at Boeing Commercial Airplanes.Larger aircraft expands capacityThe 737-10 typically seats between 185 and 210 passengers in a two-class configuration, although its maximum seating capacity reaches 230.The aircraft has a range of up to 3,100 nautical miles (5,740 kilometers). Boeing also claims it offers the lowest cost per seat among single-aisle aircraft currently in service, although that comparison was not independently established in the announcement.According to Boeing, the aircraft offers 365 nautical miles more range than competing aircraft without auxiliary fuel tanks. The company also says technological improvements across the 737 MAX program reduce fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emissions by 20%, without specifying the comparison baseline in the announcement.Airline interest in the largest MAX variant is substantial. Boeing reported 1,555 orders from more than 30 customers, representing over 30 percent of the program’s outstanding orders.Across the broader 737 MAX family, customers have placed 7,350 orders, with nearly 2,500 aircraft delivered through September 2026. The FAA certified the smaller 737-7 earlier this year. With the 737-10 now approved, Boeing has secured certification for the final member of the MAX family.However, certification does not mean the aircraft has entered commercial service. Boeing expects customer deliveries to begin in the coming months.

historyItems.originalTitle: Boeing wins FAA approval for 737 Max 10 after years of delays as Duffy says certification process should be faster
historyItems.originalSummary: (Bloomberg) -- Boeing Co. won US regulator approval for its 737 Max 10 jet, capping off a lengthy certification saga for the planemaker’s family of narrowbody aircraft that was disrupted by two fatal crashes and a series of quality lapses.The 737 Max 10 is the largest of the company’s single-aisle aircraft and is Boeing’s response to rival Airbus SE’s A321neo. The plane’s 1,500-plus order book makes it one of the more popular Max variants, purchased by US carriers like United Airlines Holdings Inc. and Alaska Air Group Inc. The Max 10’s smallest sibling, the 737 Max 7, was approved by the US Federal Aviation Administration in August.“The FAA’s decision follows a thorough review of the aircraft’s design and safety requirements,” FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said in a news release, adding that the regulator will “continue to hold Boeing to the highest safety standards” moving forward.Bloomberg reported in July that the FAA was expected to certify the Max 10 around October. The timeline was briefly in doubt after the planemaker disclosed a software glitch with the airplane’s navigation system, but an FAA panel determined the issue did not pose a safety risk.“The 737-10 offers greater capacity, longer range and the best seat economics in its class, a platform that will create more value and opportunities for airlines around the world,” Boeing Commercial Airplanes Chief Executive Officer Stephanie Pope said in a statement Tuesday.The Max 10 is one of Boeing’s most important new jets, offering airlines a solution to replace the out-of-production 757. Alongside the other Max models, the largest variant will help the planemaker repair its balance sheet and pare down debt. The aircraft can seat as many as 230 passengers and fly for up to 3,100 nautical miles, according to Boeing’s website.US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said streamlining aircraft certification is essential to America’s ability to compete with Europe and China, noting that it took nearly a decade to approve the Max 10. “I have to allow you all to certify ​aircraft faster,” Duffy told a ceremony at Boeing’s widebody site north of Seattle on Tuesday. “You have to come to the market more quickly.”Regulators in Canada and Europe are expected to complete their own Max 10 approvals in “probably a couple months,” Mike Sinnett, a Boeing executive over development programs, said later.

historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile Advances Service Readiness Ahead of Initial Space-Based Cellular Broadband Coverage in Key Global Markets
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. announced it is advancing service readiness in key global markets before the end of 2026, including the United States, Canada, Japan, United Kingdom and Saudi Arabia. AST SpaceMobile now has more than 60 gateways deployed, installed, or in planning worldwide. The expansive ground network supports AST SpaceMobile?s global commercial ecosystem with over 60 mobile network operators who cover over 3 billion subscribers, bringing a third layer of connectivity directly into the mobile networks people already use.Spectrum is a key component of this readiness. AST SpaceMobile combines strategic partner operators? spectrum with access to mobile satellite services (MSS) spectrum, targeting approximately 100 MHz of access in the United States.Its spectrum position includes access to 45 MHz of MSS mid-band spectrum in North America and priority rights to 60 MHz of S-band spectrum globally on a market-by-market basis. The company?s satellite technology can tune across approximately 1,150 MHz of low- and mid-band frequencies globally, providing flexibility to serve different markets using available partner and satellite spectrum, subject to applicable regulatory approvals. Supporting this service rollout, AST SpaceMobile?s ground network connects the company?s growing satellite constellation with mobile operators?core networks, routing voice, video and broadband data between space and ground-based infrastructure, making it a key component of the end-to-end infrastructure required to deliver space-based cellular broadband connectivity through partners to people everywhere they work, live, and travel. This integration enables operators to extend their reach beyond the limits of terrestrial coverage while evolving alongside future 3GPP standards. In the United States, the Company has already enabled over 3,000 coverage cells and expects to activate the roughly 5,600 cellular cells that cover the continuous United States before year-end.Enabling the remaining digital cells will establish the geographic footprint required to support initial, intermittent service across the contiguous United States and is a prerequisite for nationwide rollout. During this initial phase, service will be available within the satellites? coverage area.Additional spacecraft deployments will extend the duration and frequency of coverage as AST SpaceMobile advances toward continuous service. BlueBird satellites are assembled, integrated, and tested at AST SpaceMobile?s facilities in Midland, Texas, with production now progressing through BlueBird 50. Service availability will expand as satellite capacity and ground infrastructure are deployed and network integration progresses, subject to applicable authorizations.

historyItems.title: Open AI Rack 的推出是否會改變 Arista Networks 股票的投資理由？
historyItems.summary: Arista Networks 最近推出了開放式乙太網路機架規模產品組合，包括 Etherlink SU-144 架構，以支援高密度 AI 基礎設施，每個機架最多有 144 個加速器，並採用專為極端功耗和散熱需求量身定制的液冷設計。基於 ESUN 的平台和 Netdi 基金會旨在為雲端和 AI 營運商提供一種開放的、以標準為中心的專有互連替代方案，將 Arista 的硬體與 Neocloud 按代幣成本優先級和多供應商 AI 計算生態系統緊密聯繫起來。這項發展也塑造了 Arista Networks 更廣泛的投資敘述，重點是 Etherlink SU-144 AI 機架規模擴展。
historyItems.originalTitle: Is Open AI Rack Launch Altering The Investment Case For Arista Networks Stock?
historyItems.originalSummary: Arista Networks recently launched an open Ethernet rack-scale portfolio, including the Etherlink SU-144 architecture, to support high-density AI infrastructure with up to 144 accelerators per rack and liquid-cooled designs tailored for extreme power and thermal demands. The ESUN-based platforms and Netdi foundation aim to give cloud and AI operators an open, standards-focused alternative to proprietary interconnects, linking Arista's hardware closely to neocloud cost-per-token priorities and multi-vendor AI compute ecosystems. This development also shapes Arista Networks' broader investment narrative, with a focus on the Etherlink SU-144 AI rack-scale expansion.

historyItems.originalTitle: GE Vernova secures order aimed to strengthen regional energy capacity in Côte d’Ivoire
historyItems.originalSummary: Developed by Songon Energies S.A., Songon power plant is built to strengthen energy security and support future growing electricity demand in Greater Abidjan GE Vernova 9E turbine technology to support reliable power delivery for industrial growth and millions of households Infrastructure development expected to create up to 1,400 new jobs and drive positive community impact ABIDJAN, Côte d'Ivoire - [October 20, 2026] - GE Vernova announced today that it will provide the gas power technology forthe new Songon combined-cycle power plant, located in the Songon region near Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire. Following the signing of financing agreements last June, Songon Energies- Ivorian development investment company focused on advancing energy infrastructure - selected GE Vernova to supply a 9E gas turbine and generator. The plant - to be built by the EPC contractor China Energy International Engineering Co., Ltd. - is expected to deliver 372 megawatts (MW), a capacity equal to the power needs of approximately 5 million Ivorian homes. Supporting a growing national energy landscape. Côte d'Ivoire has made significant progress, reaching an electrification rate of 94.3 percent by 2024 through initiatives like the "Electricity for All Program" (PEPT), in line with the national goal to achieve universal electrification and improved power quality by 2030. Despite these gains, the nation faces an annual demand growth rate of 10 to 15 percent and rural areas still require expanded access. In this energy landscape, this new power plant will help fill a critical gap. The facility is projected to represent up to 12 percent of the country's total installed base upon its scheduled 2029 operational launch, playing a vital role in meeting these ambitious development targets. Furthermore, the project is expected to generate up to 1,400 new jobs, creating economic opportunities for the local community. "The Songon Energies project is designed to strengthen energy security and support future growing electricity demand growth in the Greater Abidjan region while reinforcing the country's position as a regional energy hub in West Africa," said Mr. Wang Xiaoming, Deputy General Manager (Acting CEO) for Songon Energies. "The facility is expected to ease energy pressure on the Abidjan metropolitan area, providing a reliable foundation for the development of skilled workers, the growth of industrial zones, the expansion of small and medium-sized enterprises, and a tangible improvement in the daily lives of millions of Ivorian households. We selected to work with GE Vernova for this new power plant, because of our deep trust in their efficient technology and their constant, proven presence in Côte d'Ivoire, which gives us great confidence in the long-term success of this facility." "We are honored to support Songon Energies with our proven 9E technology for this crucial infrastructure project," said Joseph Anis, CEO of Gas Power in Europe, Middle East, and Africa at GE Vernova. historyItems.originalTitle: Vishay Intertechnology (VSH) Launches New Sensors, Is It Still A Bargain?
historyItems.originalSummary: Highlights Vishay Intertechnology introduced automotive-grade optical sensors for battery management, energy storage and industrial automation applications. The sensors support high-speed, wear-free optical communication with electromagnetic interference immunity. The product launch expands the company's component offerings for electric vehicles, industrial equipment and other specialised electronic systems. Vishay Intertechnology (NYSE:VSH) operates in the semiconductor and electronic components sector, supplying products used in automotive systems, industrial equipment, computing hardware and other electronic applications. The company announced a new range of automotive-grade optical sensors designed for battery management, energy storage and industrial automation systems. The launch expands the company's offerings for applications that require reliable data communication in electrically demanding environments. Optical sensors can support communication between electronic components while reducing dependence on conventional electrical signalling in suitable system designs. The products are intended for applications where electromagnetic interference, operational reliability and communication integrity are important engineering considerations. historyItems.originalSummary: Partnership aims to advance solutions to improve care pathways, clinical trial matching, safety monitoring, and guideline-directed care AstraZeneca and Oracle Health and Life Sciences today announced a unique collaboration to leverage AstraZeneca's scientific, clinical development and regulatory expertise with Oracle's real-world data, cloud infrastructure, and AI-enabled clinical capabilities to accelerate clinical research and bring evidence-driven insights into care workflows to accelerate clinical trial optimisation and help more patients receive the right care sooner. Many serious conditions are diagnosed late; patients can wait a long time before they are referred and there are gaps in how we translate scientific advancements into clinical practice. This collaboration is designed to test practical ways to connect scientific research directly to clinical workflows and transform care. Initial areas of exploration include clinical trial recruitment, earlier diagnosis, drug-safety monitoring and leveraging real-world evidence across the lifecycle of a medicine. Programmes will span AstraZeneca's core disease areas including oncology, cardiovascular, renal and metabolic diseases, respiratory and immunology, and rare disease. The collaboration will span multiple international projects with key regions including the US, Middle East, and Europe working with local governments and within applicable regulations to ensure these could be scaled in the future. The first programme will focus on supporting hypertension care and clinical research in Abu Dhabi, in partnership with healthcare company, M42. This will help clinical teams identify patients with uncontrolled hypertension; implementing guideline-directed care; and improving the recruitment for clinical trials. Pascal Soriot, Chief Executive Officer, AstraZeneca said: "This unique collaboration brings leaders in healthcare and AI together at a global scale to accelerate the journey from the discovery of medicine to patient care. Combining AstraZeneca's world class science with Oracle's deep data and technology expertise, we can help clinicians identify patients sooner, optimise clinical trials, and generate evidence continuously across the lifecycle of a medicine." Mike Sicilia, chief executive officer, Oracle said: "Some of the most important opportunities for AI are in healthcare, where better use of data can help turn scientific innovation into better outcomes for patients. By bringing AstraZeneca's scientific expertise together with Oracle's data, cloud, AI, and healthcare capabilities, we have an opportunity to help accelerate research, connect more patients to clinical trials, and ultimately bring relevant insights into care faster." Anne-Claire Gerbaldi, Chief Digital, Data and AI Officer, AstraZeneca, said: "Too many patients are diagnosed late or face a long journey to get the care they need. historyItems.summary: Super Micro Computer（納斯達克GS：SMCI）宣布推出基於開放運算專案的新人工智慧和高效能運算資料中心解決方案，目標是機架規模部署。擴展後的 OCP 認可產品組合現已涵蓋用於節能、密集 AI 叢集的系統、機架、液體冷卻設備和網路硬體。該公司任命 Mark Long 為財務官，增加了西部數據和其他大型科技集團的高階主管財務經驗。基於 OCP 的人工智慧和 HPC 的推出，加上聘請 Mark Long 擔任財務官，與我們的研究標記的更廣泛的主題相一致。
historyItems.originalTitle: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Unveils OCP AI Systems And Names Mark Long CFO
historyItems.originalSummary: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) announced new Open Compute Project based AI and high performance computing data center solutions targeting rack scale deployments. The expanded OCP Accepted portfolio now covers systems, racks, liquid cooling gear, and networking hardware for energy efficient, dense AI clusters. The company named Mark Long as Chief Financial Officer, adding executive finance experience from Western Digital and other large tech groups. The OCP based AI and HPC rollout plus the hiring of Mark Long as CFO comes alongside wider themes our research has flagged. Our analysis turns up 2 warning signs (1 major) for Super Micro Computer as well. For readers tracking the build out of AI data center infrastructure, it is worth comparing Super Micro Computer with other hardware and tooling suppliers through 55 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.originalTitle: CoreWeave stock attempts to rebound on Goldman Sachs upgrade to Buy
historyItems.originalSummary: CoreWeave ( CRWV ) shares rose 3% before surrendering their gains Monday after Goldman Sachs upgraded the neocloud provider to Buy from Neutral. The analyst also raised the stock's price target from $106 to $139 per share following a sell-off of more than 25% last week. A viral chart showing CoreWeave's spiking bond yields last week underscored concerns about the company's debt-heavy balance sheet and whether it can scale its business quickly enough to cover rising interest expenses.

historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk says he's giving SpaceX stock to every kid in America
historyItems.originalSummary: Kids will soon have a financial interest in the future of space. "Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX ( SPCX ) shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many," SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk said in an X post on Monday . Musk didn't specify an age range for the proposed gift. SpaceX stock rose 1% in premarket trading on Monday.

historyItems.originalTitle: Why Intel stock just got a big upgrade
historyItems.originalSummary: After a sweeping tech stock sell-off last week, Wall Street is on the hunt for bargains. And JPMorgan ( JPM ) may have found one in chip giant Intel ( INTC ), with the stock off about 36% from the June highs. Analyst Harlan Sur upgraded his rating on Intel to Neutral from Underweight on Monday. Intel stock rose more than 4% in early trading.

historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk says he will give a SpaceX share to ‘every kid in America’
historyItems.originalSummary: Elon Musk announced on social media Monday that he intends to give one SpaceX share to each child in the United States. The post described the move as the start of a larger series of gifts. Details on timing, eligibility, or distribution remain absent from the statement. ( [1] ) Musk, who serves as chief executive of SpaceX, posted the pledge without additional explanation or follow-up instructions. The message reached his large audience on the platform and quickly drew attention from news outlets and the public. Observers noted the unusual nature of committing personal holdings to a broad group of minors across the country.

historyItems.summary: AST SpaceMobile 和 TELUS 完成了整合測試，將 TELUS 的地面無線網路與 AST SpaceMobile 的天基系統連接起來，旨在為偏遠和服務欠缺地區的加拿大智慧型手機用戶擴展直接衛星連接。 AST SpaceMobile 正面臨發射時間表的不確定性以及來自 SpaceX 在頻譜接入和衛星部署方面不斷加大的競爭壓力，而進軍衛星電話服務之際。本文探討了 AST SpaceMobile 的投資敘述如何受到發射延遲和 SpaceX 在衛星連接方面的激烈競爭的影響。
historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile launch schedule updated
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile and TELUS completed an integration test linking TELUS' terrestrial wireless network with AST SpaceMobile's space based system, aiming to extend direct satellite connectivity for Canadian smartphone users in remote and underserved areas. The push into satellite to phone service comes as AST SpaceMobile faces launch schedule uncertainty and rising competitive pressure from SpaceX in both spectrum access and satellite deployment. This article examines how AST SpaceMobile's investment narrative is affected by launch delays and intensifying SpaceX competition in satellite connectivity.
